facts.text: John has met LeBron a few times and describes him as real chill.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I've had the chance to meet him a few times. He's real chill and it was a wild experience.

facts.text: John has seen LeBron play live and found it to be a motivating experience.

evidence.quote: I also had the opportunity to see him play live. It was tough, but I learned a lot from watching a top player like him.

facts.text: John admires LeBron's work ethic and dedication to the game.

evidence.quote: I really admire his work ethic and dedication to the game, such an inspiration.

facts.text: John considers LeBron to be the man and praises his skills and leadership.

evidence.quote: And LeBron is the man - love his skills and leadership.
